name: Nova Siri Genetics
description: Italian strawberry breeding company headquartered in Policoro, Basilicata (per its own account, genetic-improvement work on strawberry began in 2006). Develops low-chilling-requirement strawberry and small-fruit varieties for temperate/Mediterranean producers. Breeds and patents strawberry cultivars including Melissa and Marimbella; reported by Hortidaily as growing strongly in Spain's Huelva region, with NSG-bred plantings reaching 58 million plants in the 2024-2025 season, a 16% increase.
